lessons.title: Area and Volume

explanation_sections.title: Area and Volume
explanation_sections.body:
Rectangle area is lw, triangle area is ½bh, parallelogram area is bh, cuboid volume is lwh and cylinder
volume is πr²h.

questions.prompt: Find the area of a triangle with base 14 cm and height 9 cm.
A parallelogram has base 12 cm and height 7 cm. Find its area.
Find the volume of a cuboid measuring 8 cm × 5 cm × 4 cm.
Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm, using π = 22/7.
A tank is 2 m × 1.5 m × 1 m. Find its capacity in litres.
